summary: The original request was to action the plan in docs/validation/client-interface-audit.md. The human then clarified that the workflow remains human-stepped—PRD, design, each phase design, and each phase implementation are kicked off separately—while phase-design and phase-implementation work is almost entirely automated unless the AI cannot safely handle a decision. The final PRD implements that clarification: no step starts its successor; every phase design requires approval of its exact reviewed bytes; phase implementation has a separate human kickoff; and routine production, review, remediation, verification, documentation, and authorized scoped commits remain internal to the active step. It also retains the audit's semantic MCP-only authority, repository fencing, worker capability enforcement, diagnosis and upgrade surfaces, CLI reduction, recovery, documentation, and verification requirements. Fresh independent remediation review passed with no findings, and the constitution review passed, was aligned, and was explicitly approved. Approving this gate accepts these exact PRD bytes and advances the workflow toward the separately human-started design step; it does not itself approve a future constitution change or authorize implementation.
